'''Vitamin syrup''' was a type of food that was given to [[Ken]] by his caretaker [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[Microchip]], during his time in the [[Lost City of the Jedi]]. He ate vitamin syrup for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Ken hated the taste.<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>
